graph TD
 subgraph Client_Layer [Client Applications Layer]
 A[React Native Mobile App\n- Customer / Staff -]
 B[Next.js Web Portal\n- Admin -]
 end

 subgraph External_Services [External Cloud & Gateway Services]
 C[SePay Payment Gateway\n- VietQR Webhook -]
 D[Cloudinary / S3 CDN\n- Image Storage -]
 end

 subgraph Backend_Layer [Core Backend Layer]
 E[ASP.NET Core 8.0 Web API\n- RESTful Engine -]
 F[Mosquitto MQTT Broker\n- Telemetry & Actuator -]
 end

 subgraph Hardware_Layer [IoT Hardware Infrastructure Layer]

 H[ESP32-CAM Modules\n- Crop Snapshots -]
 end

 subgraph Data_Layer [Data Storage Layer]
 I[(MySQL Database\n- Relational Data -)]
 end

 B <-->|HTTPS / REST API| E

 E -->|HTTPS Upload| D
 H -->|HTTP Upload| D

 E <-->|Entity Framework Core| I
 E <-->|MQTT Client| F

 G <-->|MQTT Pub/Sub| F
 H -->|HTTP Post| E",
 "config": null
